name: micropython-lsp
description: Autocomplete, type checking and inline docs for MicroPython and CircuitPython. Work on VSCode web in the browser.

basedpyright.analysis.typeshedPaths.description: Where the bundled pyright engine looks for typeshed stubs. Load-bearing: without it nothing resolves at all, builtins included, because the engine's own fallback looks for a 'typeshed-fallback' directory its browser bundle does not ship. Must be an absolute file:// URI; a bare path is resolved against the workspace root and never found.

basedpyright.analysis.logLevel.description: How much the language server itself logs. 'trace' includes import resolution (every directory it searched for a module), which is the only practical way to debug a module that will not resolve. (This key belongs to the bundled pyright engine, not to this extension; the default matches the engine's own, so it changes nothing elsewhere.)

micropython-lsp.debug.description: Mirror language server logs to the developer console, including worker boot and background-worker relay activity. The output channel always records them; this makes them visible in DevTools and in headless test runs.

micropython-lsp.trace.server.description: Trace LSP traffic between VS Code and the Python language server. 'verbose' includes message bodies. Combine with micropython-lsp.debug to see it in the console.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:integration && vscode-test-web --headless --extensionDevelopmentPath=. --extensionTestsPath=./test/integration/dist/index.js ./test/workspace
